name: agentic-doc-governance-kit
description: A template and checker toolkit for AI-agent-readable documentation governance and autonomous feature delivery.

scripts.release-check: npm test && node scripts/package-metadata-check.mjs --strict && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.check: node scripts/docs-integrity-check.mjs --check-generated && node scripts/skills-integrity-check.mjs && node scripts/agent-closeout-check.mjs --self-test && node scripts/agent-closeout-check.mjs --root examples/basic-product --feature FEAT-001
